SRC-005:R001.text: CORE-001 saio.py engine/_load_codec_from/_load_freshness_from: the one-home-per-process authority must be atomic, not check-then-act, and must key its cache on one canonical home identity

SRC-005:R002.text: CORE-002 api.py refresh_known: the one-shot startup reconciliation obligation must survive a transient failure instead of being acknowledged before the reconciliation succeeded

SRC-005:R003.text: CORE-003 external_changes.py _load/unresolved: persisted rows must satisfy the registry's own semantic invariants, not only JSON shape, so corruption cannot become a fail-open collect boundary

SRC-005:R004.text: CORE-004 external_changes.py _mark_corrupt/_save/flush/is_degraded: the corrupt fail-closed state needs one reachable evidence-safe recovery transition inside the supported state machine

SRC-005:R005.text: CORE-005 watcher.py sync/_watch_scan_root/stop and api.py _do_root_refresh/stop: lifecycle invalidation must be rechecked at commit and side-effect boundaries so stop() is a real barrier

SRC-005:R006.text: CORE-006 api.py stop and events.py EventBus: teardown must unsubscribe only Api-owned callbacks and never clear the process-global bus

SRC-005:R007.text: CORE-007 api.py set_hotkeys and hotkey.py set_hotkeys/start: the persisted-config and runtime transactions must share one exception contract so a backend-unavailable failure cannot escape the rollback

SRC-005:R008.text: CORE-008 tests/test_audit_all3.py truncation regression: the >100-finding case must construct its condition independently of the wall clock instead of expiring on a hard-coded calendar date

SRC-005:R009.text: W2-001 api.py read_file_text/write_file_text and app.js openFileViewer/save path: the file editor needs one authoritative editable-snapshot identity binding displayed bytes, existence state, save authorization and request generation, so an unseen revision cannot be overwritten and a stale OPEN response cannot replace a newer session

SRC-005:R010.text: W2-002 runtime.py _schedule_reaper/_finalize/is_stuck: proven-death finalization must be the authoritative cleanup point for the stuck-agent marker so late death cannot leave a phantom live-writer state

SRC-005:R011.text: W2-003 api.py _git_mutation_tx and ownership.py begin_app_tx/end_app_tx: two app writers on one root must be serialized across fingerprint verification and mutation, and the coverage asserting it must exercise the real transaction wrapper

SRC-005:R012.text: W2-004 runtime.py send_input/_compact_terminal: liveness validation and stdin use must share one synchronization boundary and return a structured lifecycle outcome instead of an internal fault when finalization wins the race

SRC-005:R013.text: W2-005 sessions.py finish/_retry_pending_final/history: retry admission must never silently discard a newly known terminal fact, and a bounded queue must surface a degraded durability state rather than let history fabricate an interrupted result

SRC-005:R014.text: PERF-001 watcher.py _RootRouterHandler: debounce identity must be (project, filename) rather than filename alone, and a moved event must dispatch once, so one project cannot cancel another's refresh and a single atomic move cannot be counted twice
